description: Generates a 9x9 sudoku at easy/medium/hard/expert difficulty. Every puzzle is verified to have exactly one solution. Deterministic with --seed. The canonical string format is 81 characters, row by row, "." for empty cells. Online version: https://puzzletide.com/sudoku

difficulty.description: One of: easy, medium, hard, expert (default: medium)

paper.description: PDF paper size: letter or a4 (default: letter)

pdf.description: Also write a printable PDF worksheet to <file>

seed.description: Seed for reproducible output (number or word)

solution.description: Print the solution instead of the puzzle

solutionPage.description: Omit the solution page from PDF output — set false to disable

svg.description: Also write an SVG image to <file>

name: puzzle_sudoku_generate
title: sudoku generate
